sections.title: Everything from this unit, in one description
sections.content: A schedule is just several of this unit's pieces stacked together: days, dates, -tól/-től ... -ig, and the sequencing words előbb/aztán/utána/végül from A2 Unit 1. Nothing new here grammatically — this is where it all clicks into one connected description.

items.spanish: Hétfőtől péntekig dolgozom, aztán kedden este magyarórám van.
items.english: I work Monday to Friday, and then on Tuesday evening I have Hungarian class.

items.spanish: Jövő héten van egy időpontom a fogorvosnál, október tizedikén.
items.english: Next week I have an appointment at the dentist's, on October 10th.

sections.content: Describing a whole week is really just several short sentences you already know how to build, one after another — you don't need a single longer grammar structure to sound organized.
